hook.name: GenoHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for the GENO token launch platform that serves all launch pools. Dynamically sets LP fees per swap (base fee plus configurable sniper tax, sandwich tax, donation, and dividend components) and enforces optional per-pool rules including trade caps, bundle limits, Wall Street calendar hours, Lab-only Buys via signed permits, and graduation milestones.
